title: Kotoba staged audit of the 100 JLPT learning requirements
scope: Repository backlog, not a claim that every requested feature was implemented in this change. Requirements apply to the active static application; the retained React prototype is inactive.

statusDefinitions.existing: The requested behavior is supported by the current source and cited checks, subject to explicitly stated scope limits.
statusDefinitions.implemented: Completed in the current staged change, including this audit. Final execution of cited checks is reported separately.
statusDefinitions.optional: An explicitly optional feature has not been selected or implemented; its absence does not block the current core flow.
statusDefinitions.deferred: A material part is missing. Existing partial behavior is recorded without treating the entire requirement as complete.
statusDefinitions.blocked: The remaining work depends on unavailable source material or assets; independent work can continue.

auditBasis.runtime: index.html and local classic scripts/styles/assets in web/; no npm, server, account or paid API is required for core browser use.
auditBasis.instructionFiles: No AGENTS.md was found inside the project/workspace. The inspected global C:/Users/Angelo/.codex/AGENTS.md is empty.
auditBasis.evidenceConvention: Paths are relative to the repository. Tests cited below describe concrete checked behavior; this JSON is a source audit and does not substitute for the final test execution report. Legacy src/lib/*.test.ts fixtures are distinguished from the npm-free executable check suites.
referenceLimits: Thirty N3/N2/N1 publisher volumes have verified edition, ISBN, catalog topics and representative app links. Full textbooks were not available; exact chapter, page and daily correspondences remain unverified.
The revised So-matome pacing description and Shin Kanzen skill descriptions inform an original app sequence. Completing the app does not certify complete textbook or JLPT syllabus coverage.
Listening currently uses original scripts and one device-dependent Japanese text-to-speech voice. No varied human-speaker recording library is shipped.
Mock questions are original authored pools. Results are raw accuracy, not historical papers, JLPT scaled scores, certification or pass predictions.
A successful local package/check is not evidence that this repository has already been published to GitHub Pages.

recommendedStages.name: Close the remaining core-loop gaps before expanding optional features
nextGroups: Generate a per-item curriculum coverage report and explicit provisional reference mappings; request actual chapter/sample evidence only when a precise book mapping is needed.
Add assistance events and concept/skill review records with migrations before changing mastery or adaptive scheduling.
Connect searchable mistakes to relearning lessons and fresh variant prompts; validate answer announcements and richer keyboard/audio controls.
Add timezone-boundary checks and recoverable pre-import backups. Complete a measured contrast/control-size and assistive-technology audit.

recommendedStages.name: Personalization, recall quality and honest feedback
nextGroups: Remember session preferences and offer a compact default start, configurable study budgets and separate new/review caps with workload estimates.
Add conservative typed-reading validation, staged hints, explicit recall attempts and independently configurable encouragement/motion/sounds.
Add safe private notes, concept-based session summaries, confidence-aware skill history and a small returning-learner restart.
Group navigation, provide text-size controls and measure initial payload performance before optimizing downloads or splitting content.
If selected, add a skippable N4-to-N3 readiness check with inspectable bridge recommendations.

recommendedStages.name: Optional offline delivery and motivation
nextGroups: Only after the core flow is verified, add a base-path-scoped manifest/service worker and opt-in per-unit downloads with sizes and removal controls.
If selected, define idempotent XP, explicit badge criteria and personal weekly challenges; preserve unrestricted learning and reduced-motion behavior.

requirements.summary: Inspect repository instructions, content and storage; preserve existing work.
requirements.existingBehavior: The audit inspects the active static runtime, typed content, engine, storage and deployment files. This change adds documentation only.

requirements.summary: Keep core learning on free static GitHub Pages.
requirements.existingBehavior: The public package contains static HTML and local web assets; GitHub Actions can deploy it to github.io without a runtime backend.
requirements.scopeLimit: The site is deployment-ready; this audit does not assert that publication has occurred.

requirements.summary: Require no paid API, account, subscription or credit card for learning.
requirements.existingBehavior: Learning runs from local assets and browser storage, with browser speech and synthesized optional sound cues.
requirements.scopeLimit: Publishing uses the owner's GitHub account; learners do not need an account.

requirements.summary: Support root and repository-subpath Pages assets and routes.
requirements.existingBehavior: Relative local assets, hash navigation and a packaged repository-aware 404 link support both Pages layouts.
requirements.scopeLimit: Browser checks cover packaged subpath routes, refreshes and direct-file loading; GitHub hosting itself is external.

requirements.summary: Default to local learning without undefined cloud or social hosting.
requirements.existingBehavior: Progress stays in browser-local storage and moves only through learner-initiated JSON backups. There is no cloud sync, social account or leaderboard.

requirements.summary: Use stable IDs for learning content and progress links.
requirements.existingBehavior: Canonical IDs connect units, lessons, vocabulary, kanji, grammar, passages, listening scripts, questions, attempts and study events. Additive releases preserve legacy IDs.
requirements.scopeLimit: Future reordering of generated lesson allocations must preserve their meaning or include an explicit migration.

requirements.summary: Share typed content contracts for objectives, prerequisites, answers, audio and sources.
requirements.existingBehavior: Typed content and path/reference contracts cover skills, objectives, prerequisites, canonical accepted option IDs, per-option explanations, audio URLs and related content/source IDs.
requirements.scopeLimit: Accepted answers currently mean multiple-choice keys; typed-answer variants require the extension described in #29.

requirements.summary: Version and migrate saved data without losing progress.
requirements.existingBehavior: Schema 1 and content version 2026.10.4 validate additive legacy releases and normalize new settings while preserving attempts, reviews and IDs. Unknown or corrupt versions are retained and reported.

requirements.summary: Connect the guided path to all existing study and assessment views.
requirements.existingBehavior: Integrated N3–N1 lessons link words/kanji, grammar, reading, audio, mixed retrieval, mistake review and full-mock preparation; direct study tools remain accessible.

requirements.summary: Audit and implement coherent verified stages rather than all 100 at once.
requirements.existingBehavior: This file records every requirement, partial behavior, evidence and remaining work. The current small stage adds a guided start and UI interaction refinements while preserving the core.

requirements.summary: Make the default home path actionable with prominent Start/Continue.
requirements.existingBehavior: The default home includes Learning path. Its primary path-start button opens the selected saved or next uncompleted lesson, scrolls to actual study content and saves pathResume without marking completion.
requirements.scopeLimit: Learners may deliberately hide or reorder dashboard widgets. N5/N4 remain foundation-review routes.

requirements.summary: Use verified So-matome pacing and Shin Kanzen skill guidance.
requirements.existingBehavior: The reference map records revised So-matome daily/weekly pacing and verified Shin Kanzen skill topics; the original app uses six study lessons followed by cumulative review.
requirements.scopeLimit: App unit counts are content-sized and are not invented matches to textbook weeks or chapters.

requirements.summary: Attach verified reference metadata and provisional mappings to each unit.
requirements.existingBehavior: Thirty volume records include series, edition, ISBN, topics, sources, representative app IDs and gaps; lessons link relevant volume IDs and expose these records.
gaps: Mappings are broad level/skill links, not verified per-unit chapter/topic correspondences.
Full-book chapter/day/page material is unavailable; some publisher previews were inaccessible.
requirements.nextAction: Add explicit per-unit mapping coverage/provisional metadata using accessible source evidence; retain exact correspondence gaps until actual material is available.

requirements.summary: Audit every N3 item and report unmapped content, duplicates and missing audio.
requirements.existingBehavior: Path checks cover every authored N3 word and grammar point; lessons link all skills and final revision includes the full level question pool. Content checks reject duplicate IDs/words and broken links.
gaps: No per-item audit artifact classifies all N3 kanji, passages, audio and questions as mapped/unmapped with concept-duplicate reasons.
Structural word/ID uniqueness does not establish semantic concept uniqueness or exhaustive curriculum coverage.
requirements.nextAction: Generate an item-level coverage report including representative reference coverage, duplicate concepts and synthesized-versus-recorded audio availability.

requirements.summary: Order the course by evidenced objectives and prerequisites.
requirements.existingBehavior: The path orders authored grammar families with acyclic earlier-unit prerequisites; eighteen topic tags are browsing filters. Publisher objectives and original app groupings are explicitly separated.
gaps: The precise item-to-item prerequisite order is authored guidance, not a fully verified prerequisite map from the reference curricula.
requirements.nextAction: Record concrete prerequisite concept IDs and their teaching rationale; verify available reference objectives without fabricating chapter matches.

requirements.summary: Give units practical titles, objectives, prerequisites and activity lists.
requirements.existingBehavior: Units and lessons expose descriptive grammar-family titles, objectives, prerequisite summaries and actual linked vocabulary, grammar, passage, listening and question activities.

requirements.summary: Interleave all skills and mixed retrieval in each learning unit.
requirements.existingBehavior: Daily lessons combine at most seven words and two grammar points, linked kanji, context sentences, reading, playable listening and current/earlier mixed practice.
requirements.scopeLimit: Longer passages develop related skills but do not claim to contain every daily target.

requirements.summary: Offer a skippable N4-to-N3 readiness check with inspectable bridge recommendations.
requirements.existingBehavior: N5/N4 foundation lessons and level-specific practice are available directly.
gaps: No readiness assessment scores prerequisite skills or recommends specific bridge lessons.
requirements.nextAction: If selected, author a short optional diagnostic with transparent skill-based recommendations and a Skip control.

requirements.summary: Distinguish not-started, in-progress, completed and demonstrated mastery.
requirements.existingBehavior: Manual lesson checkmarks, assessed accuracy and three-due-retry question mastery are separate. Page views do not grant completion/mastery; active attempts are saved distinctly.
gaps: The path does not explicitly render all four lifecycle states for every unit/lesson; selecting a lesson is resume state rather than recorded learning progress.
requirements.nextAction: Derive explicit lesson lifecycle labels from meaningful study/assessment evidence while preserving manual completion separately.

requirements.summary: Add cumulative review, final revision and honest original N3 mocks.
requirements.existingBehavior: Six-lesson groups end with cumulative checkpoints, followed by final revision and original full mock preparation. Official section durations and task categories inform practice; results show raw counts only.
requirements.scopeLimit: Authored question targets and synthesized/picture-free listening adaptations are not exact historical test reproduction.

requirements.summary: Offer adjustable estimated daily study time budgets.
requirements.existingBehavior: Daily lessons use small content portions and learner-controlled pacing; practice question counts are adjustable.
gaps: No five/ten/twenty-minute budget setting or measured/estimated lesson duration is shown.
requirements.nextAction: Add a saved budget preference and clearly estimated workloads without making elapsed idle time evidence of study.

requirements.summary: Provide one-click practice with saved preferences and disclosed advanced filters.
requirements.existingBehavior: Practice defaults to five mixed questions with weak-point priority; a single Start practice button launches the configured session. The learning level persists.
gaps: Skill/topic/format/count/weak-point settings are transient and visible rather than saved behind Customize session.
requirements.nextAction: Persist validated session preferences and add a compact default start with an accessible customization disclosure.

requirements.summary: Introduce new concepts with explanations and examples before dependent practice.
requirements.existingBehavior: Integrated lessons present word context, grammar explanations/examples and reading context before mixed practice. Standalone grammar also offers study before Practice this pattern.
requirements.scopeLimit: Experienced learners retain direct access to practice; prerequisite completion is suggested rather than enforced.

requirements.summary: Teach contextual vocabulary and useful collocations.
requirements.existingBehavior: Words include reading, meaning, word class, original natural example and translation; flashcards and the path preserve this context.
gaps: Collocations are implicit in examples; there is no explicit reviewed collocation teaching field or coverage audit for each word.
requirements.nextAction: Add selected useful collocations with original examples and verify their sense/register instead of treating every co-occurrence as a collocation.

requirements.summary: Teach kanji through vocabulary plus accurate components and original mnemonics.
requirements.existingBehavior: Kanji connect to real words, readings and meanings; shared characters retain canonical IDs across levels.
gaps: Component explanations and original optional mnemonics are absent.
requirements.nextAction: Add reviewed component guidance, label memory aids as original mnemonics and keep historical etymology separately sourced.

requirements.summary: Adjust learning furigana without leaking recall answers.
requirements.existingBehavior: Saved furigana controls apply to revealed study cards and flashcard answers. Quiz questions/options use Japanese text without automatic reading ruby; target/evidence glossary clues stay protected until checked.
requirements.scopeLimit: There is no explicit assisted-furigana quiz reveal; adding one requires #55/#63 assistance records.

requirements.summary: Require an explicit recall attempt before flashcard answers.
requirements.existingBehavior: Flashcard fronts invite recall before Flip card; answer-side Got it/Again controls record study/completion separately from assessed mastery.
gaps: A learner can flip immediately; no attempted-recall state or explicit Show answer when stuck is recorded.
requirements.nextAction: Add a clear recall-attempt or cannot-recall action and Show answer semantics without equating self-ratings to assessed success.

requirements.summary: Use multiple-choice, cloze, typed readings and composition with distinct evidence.
requirements.existingBehavior: The bank includes multiple-choice context/cloze, grammar form, sentence-order target and text-grammar formats with separate skill/type metadata.
gaps: Typed reading and interactive full-sentence composition are absent; all current assessed responses are option selections.
requirements.nextAction: Introduce supported response types and evidence distinctions alongside canonical accepted-answer validation and migrations.

requirements.summary: Validate typed Japanese conservatively with verified alternatives.
requirements.existingBehavior: Current grading compares canonical option IDs exactly; it does not perform unsafe free-text normalization.
gaps: There is no typed-answer schema, input, normalization policy or verified alternative-answer bank.
requirements.nextAction: Define narrow per-task normalization and accepted alternatives, with tests retaining assessed particle, kana, spelling and conjugation distinctions.

requirements.summary: Keep exercises focused with accurate counters, submission and an exit.
requirements.existingBehavior: One question is shown with question/answered counts, native answer controls and predictable Check/Next/Submit behavior. Navigation leaves the saved attempt available; mock clocks explicitly continue.
requirements.scopeLimit: Leaving untimed learning is the pause mechanism; exam time cannot be paused mid-section.

requirements.summary: Explain grammar form, meaning, register, constraints and prerequisite links.
requirements.existingBehavior: Grammar entries include meaning, attachment rules, examples, a corrected common mistake and comparison; many explain register and use constraints in prose.
gaps: Register/constraint coverage is not explicitly audited for every pattern, and targeted prerequisite-form links are absent.
requirements.nextAction: Add reviewed prerequisite IDs and explicit register/constraint notes where they affect acceptable use.

requirements.summary: Provide natural translated grammar examples with relevant sentence-part explanations.
requirements.existingBehavior: Patterns have several original translated examples plus attachment, mistake and comparison explanations.
gaps: Examples do not consistently annotate the relevant sentence parts and explain their role.
requirements.nextAction: Add focused example annotations for attachment, scope and clause relationship without duplicating entire lesson explanations.

requirements.summary: Explain distinctions between confusing grammar alternatives.
requirements.existingBehavior: Every grammar entry has a comparison and common-mistake explanation; question explanations discuss why each meaningful option fits or fails.
requirements.scopeLimit: Structural checks require explanations; targeted editorial audits improve concrete ambiguities but do not prove every linguistic judgment.

requirements.summary: Reduce grammar retrieval support progressively rather than permit example copying.
requirements.existingBehavior: Learning explanations precede related original questions; answers remain hidden until checked.
gaps: No staged support/hint ladder or prompt-variation progression is implemented; learned examples can resemble subsequent cloze contexts.
requirements.nextAction: Author fresh retrieval variants and adjustable fading hints, recording each assistance level.

requirements.summary: Offer keyboard-accessible sentence composition and grammatical explanations.
requirements.existingBehavior: Sentence-order questions show four fragments and ask which belongs at the target position; native choices work by keyboard and explanations show the complete sentence.
gaps: Learners cannot build or reorder the entire sentence with accessible move controls; existing questions assess a selected target slot.
requirements.nextAction: Add an original full-composition response type with move-up/down or equivalent keyboard controls and clause-order reasoning.

requirements.summary: Provide original N3 short, medium, long and information-retrieval reading tasks.
requirements.existingBehavior: Original practical messages, notices, articles and advertisements supply the supported N3 reading formats with explicit question-type metadata.
requirements.scopeLimit: Authored lengths and difficulty are study groupings, not certification of official calibrated difficulty.

requirements.summary: Explain submitted reading answers with supporting passage evidence.
requirements.existingBehavior: Reading feedback includes original per-option reasoning, quoted supporting evidence, and a post-submission passage/translation disclosure.

requirements.summary: Offer accessible glossary lookup and record assessment assistance.
requirements.existingBehavior: Safe background-word definitions open by hover, focus or tap; answer/evidence/shared-question clues are protected and mock lookup is disabled.
gaps: Glossary use is deliberately unrecorded and cannot be separated from unaided assessment history.
requirements.nextAction: Record relevant lookup events per attempt/question and propagate assisted-result labels without exposing protected clues.

requirements.summary: Control reading difficulty and prerequisite gaps explicitly.
requirements.existingBehavior: Passages are level-tagged, cover varied lengths/inference tasks and link related topic grammar. Original lesson examples introduce selected targets.
gaps: No item-level lexical/grammar prerequisite audit or controlled difficulty sequence establishes that every passage's unfamiliar forms were introduced.
requirements.nextAction: Annotate passage prerequisites and deliberate unknowns, then review length, inference and lexical progression independently.

requirements.summary: Bookmark concepts and store safe private notes by content ID.
requirements.existingBehavior: Vocabulary bookmarks persist, show a filled Saved indicator and filter cards/flashcard decks. Rendered app content uses text nodes.
gaps: Bookmarks do not cover every concept type; private notes and their validated backup/migration schema are absent.
requirements.nextAction: Add stable concept bookmarks and bounded plain-text notes with safe rendering and import validation.

requirements.summary: Provide real playable audio and exclude transcript-only listening evidence.
requirements.existingBehavior: Original scripts play through explicit Japanese browser speech when available; supplied audioUrl playback is supported. Script study and excluded failures have no listening accuracy/mastery contribution.
requirements.scopeLimit: No recorded audio bank is shipped; speech depends on the device/browser and is clearly labeled synthesized practice.

requirements.summary: Require learner action to start audio.
requirements.existingBehavior: Audio starts only from Play/replay; opening screens merely discovers voices. Navigation, page hiding and disposal stop playback.

requirements.summary: Offer accessible pause, replay, progress and volume with playback states.
requirements.existingBehavior: Labeled Play/replay and Stop controls expose loading, ready, starting, playing, finished, missing and error status text.
gaps: No Pause/resume, seek/progress display or volume control is exposed; Stop restarts from the beginning.
requirements.nextAction: Add meaningful supported audio controls with keyboard semantics and truthful capability fallbacks for speech synthesis.

requirements.summary: Separate slow assisted learning from normal-speed listening practice.
requirements.existingBehavior: Browser speech currently uses one fixed rate of 0.9; transcripts are classified separately.
gaps: No speed selector, normal-speed assessment mode or saved assisted-speed outcome exists.
requirements.nextAction: Add capability-aware learning speed choices and persist per-attempt playback assistance before reporting comparable results.

requirements.summary: Hide initial listening transcripts and reveal them with explanations.
requirements.existingBehavior: Audio attempts conceal the transcript initially; completed results provide transcript/translation disclosure. An explicit accommodation switches learning to unscored script study.
requirements.scopeLimit: Learner-requested early transcript access remains available under #50 and cannot count as unaided listening.

requirements.summary: Cover supported N3 listening purposes and task categories.
requirements.existingBehavior: Original N3 questions cover required actions, key points, general outline, suitable expressions and quick responses with task-specific scripts and explanations.
requirements.scopeLimit: Suitable-expression tasks use stated situations rather than claiming to reproduce official picture-based test delivery.

requirements.summary: Handle failed audio without awarding listening completion.
requirements.existingBehavior: Missing voices, playback rejection and start watchdogs show useful error/retry or script-study paths. Assessment questions can be excluded; no failure callback marks a task complete.
requirements.scopeLimit: A learner may independently set a manual completion checkmark; it remains separate from assessed listening evidence.

requirements.summary: Use licensed varied speakers when available without invented audio-quality claims.
requirements.existingBehavior: Scripts cover natural everyday and advanced contexts. The UI states that audio is device-dependent synthesized practice and uses the first available Japanese voice.
gaps: No suitable licensed or commissioned multi-speaker human recordings and associated rights/provenance metadata are available in the repository.
requirements.nextAction: When recordings and permission evidence are available, add verified speakers and quality/size metadata; keep text-to-speech claims accurate meanwhile.

requirements.summary: Load audio on demand without preloading the whole course.
requirements.existingBehavior: Speech utterances are created on Play. Supplied audio elements use preload none and release sources on disposal; the homepage does not download a course audio library.
requirements.scopeLimit: Future supplied files need measured encoding/size limits; current scripts contain no recorded audio assets.

requirements.summary: Provide transcript accommodation with honest assessment classification.
requirements.existingBehavior: Learners may reveal scripts or choose unscored script study. Seen scripts persist across the tab/reload and mark associated later listening questions unscored without blocking the course.
requirements.scopeLimit: Seen-script protection is browser-tab/session scoped, not lifelong or cross-device familiarity evidence.

requirements.summary: Show learning feedback and conceptual explanation after submission.
requirements.existingBehavior: Practice/review require Check answer before Next; checked answers lock and show outcome, canonical answer, all option explanations and applicable evidence/completed sentence.

requirements.summary: Withhold exam feedback and distinguish timed exam from learning.
requirements.existingBehavior: Full-mock section timers, locks and breaks are explicit; answers, translations and explanations remain hidden until every section is submitted.

requirements.summary: Explain correct choices and meaningful distractors.
requirements.existingBehavior: Every question has a canonical correct option and original explanations keyed to all options; feedback preserves shuffled display order while showing the correct reasoning.
requirements.scopeLimit: Structural completeness and targeted editorial corrections do not certify every distractor's linguistic quality.

requirements.summary: Offer progressive hints without prematurely showing the final answer.
requirements.existingBehavior: Answers remain hidden until Check or final submission, and safe background glosses avoid answer clues.
gaps: No authored hint ladder, hint action or explicit final-answer reveal event is implemented.
requirements.nextAction: Add staged original hints and assistance records before integrating them into grading or review scheduling.

requirements.summary: Preserve first outcomes and separately record hints, reveals, skips and retries.
requirements.existingBehavior: Saved attempt history retains original answers; aggregate accuracy distinguishes the first assessed outcome from later retries. Transcript study and technical exclusions are separate.
gaps: No per-question hint, glossary, reveal, intentional skip or recall-attempt event schema exists; unanswered counts do not identify why an item was left blank.
requirements.nextAction: Add versioned assistance/response events without rewriting historical first outcomes.

requirements.summary: Search and group a concept/skill mistake queue without duplicate cards.
requirements.existingBehavior: A persistent question-keyed queue updates repeated misses of the same question, sorts due/learning/mastered states and supports due or early retries.
gaps: No search or concept/skill grouping exists; different questions for one concept produce separate review records.
requirements.nextAction: Add searchable concept-plus-skill review grouping with preserved question evidence and a migration for existing review records.

requirements.summary: Link mistakes to immediate relearning explanations and the relevant lesson.
requirements.existingBehavior: Each mistake has an expandable original answer/explanation and an immediate Retry question action.
gaps: The mistake card does not link directly to its grammar/vocabulary lesson or a short concept-focused relearning flow.
requirements.nextAction: Resolve canonical concept IDs to focused study routes and a brief relearn-then-retrieve action.

requirements.summary: Retry missed concepts later through fresh examples.
requirements.existingBehavior: Adaptive ordinary practice transfers grammar/vocabulary weakness to related unseen questions. Scheduled mistake retries reuse the original saved question.
gaps: The due-review flow does not select fresh concept variants or distinguish correction recall from transfer to new context.
requirements.nextAction: Add reviewed variant groups and concept/skill transfer evidence without losing the original miss.

requirements.summary: Use respectful feedback with independent encouragement, animation and sound choices.
requirements.existingBehavior: Feedback is written respectfully; sound effects have a persisted mute setting and animation respects system reduced motion.
gaps: There are no independent in-app preferences for encouragement messages and animations.
requirements.nextAction: Add validated independent preferences while retaining system reduced-motion precedence and accessible written outcomes.

requirements.summary: Summarize practiced concepts, corrections, weaknesses and a useful next action.
requirements.existingBehavior: Results show raw correct/total, skill counts, unanswered/excluded items, retry labels, per-question explanations and a Finish review action without practice restrictions.
gaps: No concept-level recap identifies corrected recurring mistakes, remaining weak concepts or a targeted next lesson/review action.
requirements.nextAction: Build a concise evidence-based summary from actual attempt/concept history with optional next study and a clear stop action.

requirements.summary: Document a deterministic local spaced-review scheduler.
requirements.existingBehavior: A miss becomes due after one local calendar day. Successful due review advances through three- and seven-day intervals; three successful due retries mark the question mastered. Early success does not advance it.
requirements.scopeLimit: This is an explicit simple rule set, not an asserted implementation of Anki FSRS or another adaptive algorithm.

requirements.summary: Keep mastery evidence specific to the assessed skill.
requirements.existingBehavior: Review evidence belongs to a specific question and skill; one result does not master a word's other questions/skills. Manual flashcard/lesson checks do not alter assessed accuracy or mastery.
requirements.scopeLimit: Question mastery is deliberately narrower than demonstrated concept transfer; #58/#64 record that remaining work.

requirements.summary: Schedule distinct outcomes for unaided, assisted, revealed and failed recall.
requirements.existingBehavior: Correct/incorrect due retries drive the scheduler; script-assisted listening and excluded failures cannot advance assessment mastery.
gaps: General hint/glossary/reveal assistance is not recorded, so the scheduler cannot distinguish these outcomes from unaided answers.
requirements.nextAction: Define conservative assistance-aware scheduling rules and migrate event history before enabling new assisted answer flows.

requirements.summary: Require spaced recall and prevent identical-prompt mastery inflation.
requirements.existingBehavior: Only three correct due-review sessions separated by scheduled dates mark a question mastered; immediate/early success and ordinary repeated practice do not advance its streak.
gaps: All three due successes may use the same original prompt; there is no fresh-variant concept-transfer requirement.
requirements.nextAction: Keep current question-level mastery clearly scoped and add separate fresh-context evidence before claiming strong concept mastery.

requirements.summary: Store consistent due timestamps and explicitly handle local timezone changes.
requirements.existingBehavior: Study/review timestamps use UTC ISO strings; local calendar arithmetic preserves time of day and dates render in the browser locale.
gaps: The UI does not display the active timezone or an explicit timezone-change policy.
No executable multi-timezone, DST and timezone-change regression matrix is present; a retained legacy test covers local midnight.
requirements.nextAction: Publish a consistent timezone policy, show the current zone, and test calendar/DST/travel boundaries using the npm-free suite.

requirements.summary: Configure new and review batch sizes with visible workload.
requirements.existingBehavior: Ordinary practice supports one to one hundred questions with an available-pool count; due review starts a fixed five-question batch and path daily portions are fixed.
gaps: No separate saved new-item/review caps or combined workload preview exists.
requirements.nextAction: Add independent validated caps and a pre-session due/new/earlier breakdown.

requirements.summary: Retain overdue review items after missed days.
requirements.existingBehavior: Unmastered records remain due whenever dueAt is at or before now; missed days do not delete records or reset the course.

requirements.summary: Separate scheduled review and optional extra practice predictably.
requirements.existingBehavior: Due review, Practice early and ordinary practice are distinct. Early correct answers do not advance due mastery; any new assessed miss resets learning and schedules the next local day. Rules are shown and documented.

requirements.summary: Reduce recommended new study when review backlog grows, with override.
requirements.existingBehavior: Practice prioritizes due and recently missed questions while reserving some unseen material; dashboard shows the due count.
gaps: No backlog-sensitive new-item recommendation, rationale or explicit override is presented.
requirements.nextAction: Show an inspectable recommended new/review mix based on backlog, retaining learner control.

requirements.summary: Mix due, recent, earlier and new material with varied nonduplicate session prompts.
requirements.existingBehavior: Adaptive selection ranks due/recent misses and weak related concepts, reserves unseen material and deduplicates a session. Path practice adds up to four earlier questions to current material with shuffled tie selection.
requirements.scopeLimit: Future concept-level due review still needs fresh variants under #58; this requirement describes available mixed practice.

requirements.summary: Let learners choose meaningful activity-based goals without counting idle time.
requirements.existingBehavior: A saved one-to-one-thousand learning-action goal counts studied content once per local item/day and answered nonexcluded questions in submitted sessions. Page views and idle time do not count.
requirements.scopeLimit: The supported goal basis is learning activities; active-time goals are not implemented.

requirements.summary: Show timezone-aware meaningful streaks and test midnight/travel boundaries.
requirements.existingBehavior: Streaks use local calendar days containing actual recorded study or submitted answered activity, with no idle/page-view credit. A retained fixture tests item/day deduplication across midnight.
gaps: The active local timezone is not visible; timezone changes/DST and streak boundary behavior lack the requested executable test matrix.
requirements.nextAction: Display the zone and test streak computation across midnight, DST and timezone changes without silently rewriting historical activity.

requirements.summary: Welcome returning learners with a small restart and intact history.
requirements.existingBehavior: Completed tasks, reviews and historical attempts persist after inactivity; saved sessions remain resumable.
gaps: No returning-after-missed-days message or small tailored restart session is offered.
requirements.nextAction: Offer an optional short due/earlier restart without resetting progress or pressuring the learner.

requirements.summary: Keep learning and retries unrestricted after mistakes.
requirements.existingBehavior: There are no hearts, energy limits, payments or incorrect-answer penalties blocking practice; due and early retries remain accessible.

requirements.summary: If XP is added, define rules and award each event once.
requirements.existingBehavior: No XP system exists; study events and submissions are already idempotent for their supported purposes.
gaps: XP rules, event-award IDs and reward display are absent because XP has not been selected.
requirements.nextAction: Only if selected, define qualifying events and persisted idempotent award records before exposing points.

requirements.summary: Offer optional measurable badges with visible criteria.
requirements.existingBehavior: Completion checks and review streaks provide evidence that could support badges; no achievement reward system is claimed.
gaps: Achievement badges and their criteria/award records are not implemented; UI status badges are not achievement badges.
requirements.nextAction: If selected, choose few measurable criteria and expose how each badge was earned.

requirements.summary: Use the existing mascot for restrained optional encouragement.
requirements.existingBehavior: Momo remains the original Kotoba mascot. A brief user-triggered logo celebration and restrained UI motion respect reduced-motion preferences; no celebration is required to study.
requirements.scopeLimit: Independent encouragement/motion preferences remain deferred under #59; this is a small voluntary mascot interaction.

requirements.summary: Offer optional meaningful personal weekly challenges without competition.
requirements.existingBehavior: Daily action goals and a recent-week habit display exist locally, with no public competition.
gaps: No personal weekly challenge configuration, progress record or completion criteria exists.
requirements.nextAction: If selected, add an opt-in local challenge based on listening activity or due review, without restricting other study.

requirements.summary: Show sampled skill progress with assisted/unaided and limited-history caveats.
requirements.existingBehavior: Skill balance shows first-assessed correct/total counts and no-assessed-history text; initial/retry history is separated and transcript listening is excluded.
gaps: General assistance is unrecorded, so unaided/assisted breakdowns are unavailable; small nonzero sample counts have no confidence/trend caveat.
requirements.nextAction: Add assistance-aware sample counts and restrained limited-history messaging before introducing trends.

requirements.summary: Keep completion, accuracy, scores, effort and mastery honest and separate.
requirements.existingBehavior: Manual checkmarks, daily learning actions, first/retry accuracy, raw mock scores and spaced-review question mastery are independent and explicitly labeled. No pass probability or certification is shown.

requirements.summary: Group navigation into learning, practice/review and utilities.
requirements.existingBehavior: All nine direct routes have text/icons and aria-current active indicators; mobile quick navigation and the full menu preserve access.
gaps: The desktop/sidebar route list is flat and does not render the requested learning, practice/review and utilities groups.
requirements.nextAction: Introduce semantic group labels without changing existing routes or hiding utilities.

requirements.summary: Keep desktop layouts compact with actions near their settings.
requirements.existingBehavior: Study menus follow the selected article's natural height, setup controls share a compact card, and flashcards reserve a stable frame with reachable overflowing definitions.
requirements.scopeLimit: A long integrated lesson remains a scrollable study flow rather than forcing all content into a viewport.

requirements.summary: Stack mobile content with accessible collapsible navigation and reachable controls.
requirements.existingBehavior: Responsive layouts stack content, cap mobile study menus, and expose labeled Menu toggles with expanded/controls state and Escape focus return. Browser checks exercise narrow screens and overflow.
requirements.scopeLimit: Verified Chrome desktop/mobile emulation is not a claim that every browser/device has been checked.

requirements.summary: Share design tokens and truthful native-browser control fallbacks.
requirements.existingBehavior: Shared light/dark tokens cover surfaces, text, actions, borders and focus. Dropdown enhancement retains native selects as fallback; scrollbar styling is progressive and system fonts are used.
requirements.scopeLimit: Native appearance and scrollbar behavior may differ across browsers; identical rendering is not promised.

requirements.summary: Provide readable Japanese text and adjustable text sizing.
requirements.existingBehavior: System/Japanese font fallbacks, passage line spacing, wrapping and browser zoom support readable long text.
gaps: There is no saved app text-size preference; small instruction/status text and 200% text-resize/reflow have not been comprehensively checked.
requirements.nextAction: Add a consistent text-size setting and verify zoom/reflow with Japanese passages, fixed frames and controls.

requirements.summary: Verify a WCAG 2.2 AA target rather than assume conformance.
requirements.existingBehavior: Visible focus, labels, text/icons beside status colors, skip navigation and responsive control journeys are present and exercised.
gaps: No complete contrast-ratio, target-size, zoom/reflow, screen-reader and interaction audit establishes WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
requirements.nextAction: Measure the relevant criteria and test assistive technology; fix concrete failures and document remaining browser-specific limits.

requirements.summary: Support keyboard navigation, answers, current ordering tasks, dialogs and audio.
requirements.existingBehavior: Native radios/buttons support answers, target-slot ordering and audio; enhanced dropdowns support arrows/typeahead/Enter/Escape. Dialogs contain focus deliberately and Escape restores it; skip/menu controls work by keyboard.
requirements.scopeLimit: Full-sentence interactive ordering remains unimplemented under #35; this describes the actual option-based ordering exercises.

requirements.summary: Label semantics and announce feedback/errors without unexpected focus movement.
requirements.existingBehavior: Headings, Japanese lang attributes, field labels, fieldsets/legends and status/error regions exist; focus is captured/restored through rerenders and dialogs.
gaps: Answer explanation/outcome containers have no dedicated live announcement; relevant feedback has not been verified with a screen reader.
requirements.nextAction: Announce a concise answer outcome via a stable live region and verify focus/announcement order without rereading the full explanation.

requirements.summary: Respect reduced motion and optional sound with understandable static transitions.
requirements.existingBehavior: Page, lesson, feedback, dropdown and completion effects have reduced-motion fallbacks; sound effects can be muted and outcomes remain written. The optional mascot interaction follows the same motion preference.
requirements.scopeLimit: Independent app animation preferences remain deferred under #59; system reduced motion already takes precedence.

requirements.summary: Persist supported theme, furigana, playback and display preferences consistently.
requirements.existingBehavior: Theme, furigana, sound effects, selected study level, dashboard order/visibility and lesson resume persist and travel through validated backups.
gaps: Playback rate/volume and text-size settings do not exist; transient flashcard/session preferences are not persisted across visits.
requirements.nextAction: Persist newly supported preferences with validated defaults and consistent screen behavior, without claiming unavailable playback controls.

requirements.summary: Autosave resume, answers and results; report persistence failures honestly.
requirements.existingBehavior: Lesson ID, answer selections, checked outcomes and submitted results save through validated storage. Saved appears only after successful writes; blocked/quota/corrupt storage shows warnings, retry and export recovery.
requirements.scopeLimit: Question reload resumes the first unfinished item rather than persisting arbitrary scroll/cursor position; lesson resume is the canonical lesson ID.

requirements.summary: Validate versioned imports, preview conflicts and retain a pre-replacement backup.
requirements.existingBehavior: JSON export is versioned. Imports are size-bounded, validated before a confirmation with imported record counts, and invalid imports preserve current data. Corrupt original saved bytes remain recoverable.
gaps: The confirmation does not compare conflicts/current-versus-imported state or offer a merge preview.
A recoverable backup of valid current progress is not automatically retained before a confirmed replacement.
requirements.nextAction: Show concrete replacement differences and save/export a recoverable pre-import snapshot before replacing valid progress.

requirements.summary: Explain local storage and confirm destructive reset inside the app.
requirements.existingBehavior: Settings explains browser/device-local storage and origin/browser changes. Reset requires an explicit in-app dialog, Cancel/Escape preserves progress and confirmed reset clears supported learning records.

requirements.summary: Optionally add base-path-scoped installable offline support after core verification.
requirements.existingBehavior: Direct-file loading uses local assets without npm or a server; hosted use is static but does not promise offline reloads.
gaps: There is no install manifest, scoped service worker or managed offline cache.
requirements.nextAction: If selected after core verification, implement opt-in offline support and test root/project scopes, upgrades and cache recovery.

requirements.summary: Allow deliberate per-unit/audio downloads with size and removal controls.
requirements.existingBehavior: Learners can download progress JSON; local static files can be copied manually. Audio is generated on demand rather than downloaded as a managed library.
gaps: There is no selected-unit download manager, offline availability/size view or asset-removal UI independent of progress.
Downloadable licensed audio files are not available; browser speech may depend on a network-backed voice.
requirements.nextAction: After #94 and licensed-asset planning, add explicit per-unit caching with byte estimates and removal that leaves learning records intact.

requirements.summary: Keep data local, avoid trackers and safely render/import public frontend data.
requirements.existingBehavior: The active app has no analytics/cloud data transmission. Import accepts only validated canonical progress fields; UI rendering uses text nodes and the publisher/test links are explicit external navigation.
requirements.scopeLimit: Future notes/downloaded assets still require validation. No secrets are needed or intentionally included; this is not a general repository secret-scanner result.

requirements.summary: Optimize payloads and slower connections using measurements.
requirements.existingBehavior: A small local SVG, system fonts, on-demand audio and 24-card pagination avoid external font/image libraries or eager audio downloads.
gaps: The entire generated content bank loads initially; there is no measured slow-network performance budget or content/code splitting analysis.
requirements.nextAction: Measure packaged transfer sizes and first usable study under throttling, then optimize only demonstrated bottlenecks while preserving no-npm/direct-file use.

requirements.summary: Use reproducible checks and publish only intended assets from trusted branches.
requirements.existingBehavior: Node-only generation/check/package commands produce _site from public HTML/web assets. Pull requests run checks; deployment permissions and publication are restricted to main/master trusted-branch runs.
requirements.scopeLimit: No actual remote deployment is asserted. Browser journeys run locally; the workflow currently runs native content/logic checks.

requirements.summary: Test grading, scheduling, dates, idempotence, migration, recovery, resume, audio, keyboard and Pages.
requirements.existingBehavior: Executable native and Chrome/CDP suites exercise grading, due transitions, idempotent submit, migrations, corrupt/import recovery, reload/resume, failed speech, keyboard/dropdowns/dialogs and packaged subpath/direct-file routes.
gaps: The retained midnight fixture is in the inactive npm-based test setup; executable DST, timezone-change and midnight/streak boundary cases remain incomplete.
Screen-reader feedback and complete WCAG target verification remain unverified under #86/#88.
requirements.nextAction: Port consequential calendar boundary cases into the active native suite and add the focused accessibility verification needed by new interactions.

requirements.summary: Document operation and report all requirements with evidence and unresolved gaps.
requirements.existingBehavior: README documents setup, direct-file/local use, GitHub Pages packaging, learning behavior, backup recovery and check commands. This machine-readable file records all one hundred requirements, complete/partial/optional states and next stages.
requirements.scopeLimit: Statuses describe this audited repository stage and must be updated when later features or source evidence change.
